concept: Review and integration: a personal practice of seeing systems, not just events
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across mapping root systems, anticipating second-order effects, and cross-domain thinking — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what systems thinking means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
